title: Burj Khalifa Ke Hairaan Kar Dene Wale Facts
description: Duniya ki sabse oonchi imaarat ke baare mein kamaal ke facts.

scenes.text: Burj Khalifa duniya ki sabse oonchi imaarat hai, aur iski oonchai hai poore 828 meter.
Isme 163 floors hain, aur yeh 2010 mein khuli thi.
Yeh Eiffel Tower se lagbhag 2.5 guna oonchi hai.
Pehle iska naam Burj Dubai tha, baad mein Abu Dhabi ke shaasak Sheikh Khalifa ke naam par Burj Khalifa rakha gaya.
Iska design Y shape ka hai, jo hawa ke dabav ko sambhalne mein madad karta hai.
Filhaal yeh sabse oonchi hai, par Jeddah Tower 2028 tak isse aage nikalne ki taiyaari mein hai. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Paani Par Basa Shehar: Venice
description: Venice ke baare mein dilchasp facts.

scenes.text: Ek aisa shehar jahan sadkein nahi, bas paani ke raaste hain. Yeh hai Venice.
Venice lagbhag 118 chhote islands par basa hai, jo lagbhag 400 pulon se jude hue hain.
Yahan ke purane hisse mein gaadiyan chalti hi nahi, log paidal ya naav se aate jaate hain.
Yahan ki imaarat lakdi ke khambon par khadi hain, jo samundar ke neeche gaadi gayi hain.
Baarish aur samundar ke paani ki wajah se yahan baar baar baadh aati hai.
Zindagi mein ek baar dekhne layak shehar hai. Aise aur facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Jaipur Ko Pink City Kyun Kehte Hain?
description: Jaipur ke gulabi rang ki kahani.

scenes.text: Jaipur ko Pink City kyun kehte hain? Iski kahani bahut dilchasp hai.
Jaipur ko 1727 mein Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh ne basaya tha.
Kaha jaata hai ki 1876 mein Prince of Wales ke swagat ke liye shehar ko gulabi rang diya gaya.
Tab se purane shehar ki imaarton ka yeh rang aaj tak banaye rakha gaya hai.
Jaipur ko planned tareeke se, seedhi sadkon aur blocks mein basaya gaya tha, jo us zamane mein bahut khaas baat thi.
2019 mein Jaipur ko UNESCO World Heritage ka darja mila. Aise aur facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Duniya Ka Doosra Sabse Chhota Desh: Monaco
description: Monaco ke baare mein hairaan kar dene wale facts.

scenes.text: Ek desh jo itna chhota hai ki aap use paidal ek din mein ghoom sakte ho. Yeh hai Monaco.
Monaco ka kshetrafal sirf 2 square kilometer ke aas paas hai, aur yeh Vatican ke baad doosra sabse chhota desh hai.
Itni kam jagah mein bhi yahan bahut mehengey ghar aur yachts dikhte hain.
Yahan har saal Formula 1 ki mashoor Monaco Grand Prix hoti hai, jo shehar ki tang sadkon par chalti hai.
Yahan rehne walon mein kaafi kam log asli Monaco ke naagrik hain.
Chhota desh, bada naam. Aise aur facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Maldives: Duniya Ka Sabse Neecha Desh
description: Maldives ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Ek aisa desh jo samundar se bas thoda hi oopar hai. Yeh hai Maldives.
Maldives zameen se average sirf lagbhag 1.5 meter oopar hai, yaani duniya ka sabse neecha desh.
Yeh lagbhag 1,200 chhote coral islands se milkar bana hai.
Yahan ke kai resorts paani ke oopar bane villas ke liye mashoor hain.
Samundar ka jalstar badhne se Maldives jaise desh khatre mein hain, isliye yahan jalvayu parivartan ek bada mudda hai.
Jannat jaisa nazara, par ek badi chunauti ke saath. Follow karo.

title: Duniya Ki Sabse Oonchi Murti Bharat Mein
description: Statue of Unity ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Duniya ki sabse oonchi murti Bharat mein hai. Jaante ho kahan?
Gujarat mein Narmada nadi ke paas Statue of Unity, jo Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ko samarpit hai.
Iski oonchai 182 meter hai, jo Statue of Liberty se lagbhag do guna zyada hai.
Ise 31 October 2018 ko kholaa gaya, jo Sardar Patel ka janmdin hai.
Upar ek viewing gallery hai jahan se Narmada ka nazara dikhta hai.
Yeh Bharat ke liye garv ki baat hai. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Taj Mahal Ke Raaz Jo Kam Log Jaante Hain
description: Taj Mahal ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Taj Mahal ko sab jaante hain, par iske kuch facts shayad aap nahi jaante.
Ise Mughal badshah Shah Jahan ne apni begum Mumtaz Mahal ki yaad mein banwaya tha.
Ise banane mein lagbhag 20 saal se zyada lage, aur kaha jaata hai ki hazaron karigar yahan kaam karte the.
Iska safed marble Rajasthan ke Makrana se laya gaya tha.
Subah, dopahar aur shaam ko iska rang alag dikhta hai, kyunki roshni badalti rehti hai.
Taj Mahal 1983 se UNESCO World Heritage Site hai. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Japan Ki Bullet Train Ka Kamaal
description: Shinkansen ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Japan ki bullet train Shinkansen ko duniya ki sabse bharosemand trains mein ginte hain.
Yeh 1964 mein shuru hui, aur duniya ki pehli high speed rail line maani jaati hai.
Kaha jaata hai ki shuru hone ke baad se patri se utarne ya takraane ki wajah se kisi yatri ki jaan nahi gayi.
Yahan ek minute ki deri bhi badi baat maani jaati hai.
Iski raftaar lagbhag 300 km per hour hoti hai.
Bharat mein bhi Mumbai Ahmedabad bullet train par kaam chal raha hai. Follow karo.

title: Duniya Ka Sabse Bada Mandir
description: Angkor Wat ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Duniya ka sabse bada dharmik smarak ek mandir hai, aur yeh Bharat mein nahi, Cambodia mein hai.
Iska naam Angkor Wat hai, jo 12 vi sadi mein raja Suryavarman dwitiya ne banwaya tha.
Yeh pehle Bhagwan Vishnu ko samarpit ek Hindu mandir tha.
Baad mein yeh Buddhist upasna ka kendra ban gaya.
Iski tasveer Cambodia ke jhande par bhi hai, yaani yeh wahan ka rashtriya pratik hai.
Sooraj nikalne ke time iska nazara kamaal ka hota hai. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Konark Ka Sooraj Mandir: Pahiyon Wala Mandir
description: Konark Sun Temple ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Bharat mein ek mandir hai jo ek vishal rath jaisa dikhta hai. Yeh hai Konark ka Sooraj Mandir.
Yeh Odisha mein hai aur 13 vi sadi mein banaya gaya tha.
Mandir ko 24 pahiyon wale rath ki tarah banaya gaya hai, jise 7 ghode kheench rahe hain.
Kaha jaata hai ki iske pahiye dhoop ghadi ki tarah kaam karte hain aur samay bata sakte hain.
Purane samay mein samundri naavik ise Black Pagoda kehte the.
Yeh UNESCO World Heritage Site hai. Aise aur facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Thanjavur Ka Brihadeeswara Mandir
description: Hazaar saal purane mandir ke facts.

scenes.text: Hazaar saal purana ek mandir jo aaj bhi shaan se khada hai: Thanjavur ka Brihadeeswara Mandir.
Ise Chola raja Raja Raja pratham ne banwaya, aur yeh lagbhag 1010 isvi mein poora hua.
Iska mukhya shikhar lagbhag 66 meter oonchaa hai.
Kaha jaata hai ki shikhar ke oopar ka pathar lagbhag 80 tonne ka hai.
Yeh mandir zyada tar granite se bana hai, aur isme gazab ki nakkashi hai.
Yeh UNESCO World Heritage Site hai, Bharat ki shaan. Follow karo.

title: Ek Hi Pathar Se Bana Kailasa Mandir
description: Ellora ke Kailasa Mandir ke facts.

scenes.text: Sochiye ek poora mandir sirf ek hi bade pathar ko kaat kar banaya gaya ho. Yeh hai Kailasa Mandir.
Yeh Maharashtra ke Ellora mein hai aur 8 vi sadi mein Rashtrakuta shaasakon ke samay banaya gaya.
Ise upar se neeche ki taraf pahaad ko kaat kar banaya gaya, yaani pehle chhat, phir deewarein.
Isme vishal mandir, stambh aur murtiyan sab ek hi chattan se tarashe gaye hain.
Itna bada kaam bina aaj ki machines ke kiya gaya, yeh kisi ajoobe se kam nahi.
Ellora UNESCO World Heritage Site hai. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Golden Temple Ke Khaas Facts
description: Harmandir Sahib ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Amritsar ka Golden Temple, jise Harmandir Sahib kehte hain, Sikh dharm ka sabse pavitra sthal hai.
Iske chaaron taraf darwaze hain, jo sandesh dete hain ki yahan har dharm ke log aa sakte hain.
Yahan roz langar chalta hai jisme hazaron log bina kisi bhed bhav ke muft khana khate hain.
Mandir ka oopri hissa sone ki parat se dhaka hua hai.
Yeh ek pavitra sarovar ke beech mein bana hai, aur raat ko iska nazara kamaal ka hota hai.
Seva aur barabari ka ek sundar udaharan. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Delhi Ke Akshardham Ka Record
description: Akshardham Mandir ke facts.

scenes.text: Delhi ka Akshardham Mandir sirf sundar hi nahi, record bhi bana chuka hai.
Yeh 2005 mein khula, aur 2007 mein Guinness World Records ne ise duniya ka sabse bada vyapak Hindu mandir parisar mana.
Isme gulabi balua pathar aur safed marble ka istemal hua hai.
Mandir ki deewaron aur khambhon par hazaron murtiyan aur nakkashi ki gayi hai.
Yahan sham ko hone wala water show bhi bahut mashoor hai.
Delhi aaye toh zaroor dekhna. Aise aur facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Duniya Ki Pehli Car Kaise Bani
description: Karl Benz aur pehli petrol car ki kahani.

scenes.text: Duniya ki pehli petrol car kaun si thi? Aaiye jaante hain.
1886 mein Germany ke Karl Benz ne Benz Patent Motorwagen ka patent karaya, jise pehli petrol car maana jaata hai.
Isme sirf teen pahiye the aur yeh ek chhote se engine se chalti thi.
Karl Benz ki patni Bertha Benz ne 1888 mein lagbhag 100 kilometer ki pehli lambi yatra ki.
Kaha jaata hai ki raste mein fuel khatam hua toh unhone ek dawai ki dukaan se fuel khareeda.
Is yatra ne duniya ko dikhaya ki car bharosemand ho sakti hai. Follow karo.

title: Maruti 800: Bharat Ki Awaam Ki Car
description: Maruti 800 ki kahani.

scenes.text: Ek zamana tha jab Bharat mein car khareedna sapna tha. Phir aayi Maruti 800.
Yeh 1983 mein launch hui, aur pehli car Harpal Singh ko di gayi.
Us samay iski keemat lagbhag 47,500 rupaye thi.
Yeh chhoti, kam kharch aur chalane mein aasaan thi, isliye lakhon parivaaron ki pehli car bani.
Iska production 2014 mein band ho gaya, par log aaj bhi ise pyaar se yaad karte hain.
Aapki pehli car kaun si thi? Comment mein batao aur follow karo.

title: Tata Nano: Ek Lakh Rupaye Ki Car
description: Tata Nano ke peeche ki kahani.

scenes.text: Ek lakh rupaye mein car, yeh sunkar kaisa lagta hai? Tata Nano ka yehi sapna tha.
Ratan Tata ka maksad ek aisi car banana tha jo aam parivaar bhi kharid sake.
Kaha jaata hai ki scooter par poore parivaar ko dekhkar unhe yeh idea aaya.
Nano 2008 mein dikhayi gayi aur 2009 mein launch hui.
Ek wajah yeh maani jaati hai ki log ise sasti car ke tag se jodkar dekhne lage.
Is kahani se seekh milti hai ki product ke saath uski image bhi matter karti hai. Follow karo.

title: Bugatti: Raftaar Ka Badshah
description: Bugatti ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: Duniya ki sabse tez cars mein Bugatti ka naam sabse upar aata hai.
Bugatti Veyron 2005 mein aayi aur isme 1000 se zyada horsepower ka 16 cylinder engine tha.
Isne 400 km per hour se zyada ki raftaar ka record banaya.
2019 mein Bugatti Chiron ke ek khaas prototype ne 490 km per hour ka aankda paar kiya.
Itni raftaar sambhalne ke liye iske tyres aur parts bahut khaas banaye jaate hain.
Bugatti ki kai cars karodon rupaye ki hoti hain. Aise facts ke liye follow karo.

title: Ferrari Ke Logo Ka Raaz
description: Ferrari ke logo ki kahani.

scenes.text: Ferrari ke logo par ek ghoda kyun hai? Iske peeche ek sachi kahani hai.
Yeh ghoda Italy ke ek pehle vishwayuddh ke pilot Francesco Baracca ke jahaaz par bana hota tha.
Enzo Ferrari ko 1923 mein Baracca ke parivaar se is nishaan ko apnane ka sujhav mila.
Logo ka peela rang Italy ke Modena shehar ka rang hai, jahan Enzo Ferrari ka janm hua tha.
Ferrari ki pehli road car 1947 mein bani thi.
Lal rang aur uda hua ghoda, ek poori kahani. Follow karo.

title: Tractor Se Supercar Tak: Lamborghini
description: Lamborghini ki kahani.

scenes.text: Lamborghini supercars banane se pehle kya banati thi? Jawab hai, tractor.
Ferruccio Lamborghini pehle tractor banane ka kaam karte the.
Unhone 1963 mein apni sports car company shuru ki.
Kaha jaata hai ki Ferrari se hui ek baatcheet ne unhe apni car banane ke liye prerit kiya.
Logo par saand hai, kyunki unki rashi Vrishabh thi aur unhe bullfighting pasand thi.
Isiliye kai Lamborghini cars ke naam ladne wale saandon par rakhe gaye hain. Follow karo.

title: Sachin Tendulkar Ke Kamaal Ke Records
description: Sachin Tendulkar ke records.

scenes.text: Cricket ke bhagwan kahe jaane wale Sachin Tendulkar ke kuch records aaj bhi yaad kiye jaate hain.
Unhone sirf 16 saal ki umar mein 1989 mein Bharat ke liye debut kiya.
Unke naam international cricket mein 100 shatak hain, jo ek aisa aankda hai jo ab tak koi aur nahi chhoo paya.
2010 mein ve purushon ke ODI cricket mein double century lagane wale pehle khiladi bane.
2014 mein unhe Bharat Ratna mila, aur ve yeh samman paane wale pehle khiladi bane.
Unki mehnat aur lagan se bahut kuch seekhne ko milta hai. Follow karo.

title: Shah Rukh Khan Ka Safar
description: Shah Rukh Khan ke career ke facts.

scenes.text: Shah Rukh Khan ko Bollywood ka Badshah kaha jaata hai, par unka safar chhote parde se shuru hua tha.
Unhone 1988 mein TV serial Fauji se apne career ki shuruaat ki.
1992 mein film Deewana se unka Bollywood safar shuru hua.
Unhe 2005 mein Padma Shri samman se nawaza gaya.
Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge jaisi unki film ne cinema mein lambe samay tak chalne ka record banaya.
Mehnat aur lagan ki misaal. Aise aur facts ke liye follow karo.

title: A. R. Rahman Ka Oscar Wala Safar
description: A. R. Rahman ke sangeet ke safar ke facts.

scenes.text: Sangeet ki duniya mein A. R. Rahman ka naam bahut izzat se liya jaata hai.
1992 ki Tamil film Roja se unki pehchaan bani, jisme unhe National Film Award bhi mila.
2009 mein Slumdog Millionaire ke liye unhe do Oscar mile.
Yeh sammaan unhe film ke sangeet aur gaane Jai Ho ke liye mile.
Uske baad unhe do Grammy Awards bhi mile.
Mehnat aur riyaaz se sapne poore hote hain. Follow karo.

title: MS Dhoni Ke Kamaal Ke Facts
description: MS Dhoni ke baare mein facts.

scenes.text: MS Dhoni Bharat ke sabse safal captains mein se ek maane jaate hain.
Cricket mein aane se pehle unhone Kharagpur railway station par ticket collector ki naukri ki thi.
Ve ek hi aise captain hain jisne ICC ki teeno bade white ball trophies jeete.
2007 T20 World Cup, 2011 ODI World Cup aur 2013 Champions Trophy, teeno mein Bharat ne unki captaincy mein jeet hasil ki.
2011 mein unhe Territorial Army mein honorary Lieutenant Colonel ka rank bhi diya gaya.
Chhote shehar se bade sapne ki misaal. Follow karo.
